messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix deploy request: embeds service image rwinference/embeds:1.4.1-hotfix. CI green. Preflight passed. Requesting expedited canary now. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1813456789 :rocket:

eng-release: Short summary: a recent change to batch key hashing caused a small percent of tiny requests to be misrouted, increasing p99. Patch fixes hashing fallback. Rollback target: rwinference/embeds:1.4.0.

sre-jai: Need explicit rollback triggers and who will cut traffic. Suggest triggers: p99 +400ms for 3m, error-rate +1% sustained 2m, or any 5xx spike >0.5%. Who's monitoring?

oncall-maria: I'm oncall and will monitor. Pager set to high for 90m. If thresholds hit, I'll post "ROLLBACK INTENT" here and execute traffic cut.

release-mgr-olivia: Product ack required before expedited path. Also request a short customer-facing blurb for release notes.

product-nina: Product acked. Blurb: "Fix routing for very short embedding requests causing intermittent latency spikes. No model changes." Approved for fast roll.

eng-release: +1 from eng (codeowners approve). Plan: canary in eu-west1 5m, ramp 20% -> 60% -> 100% if healthy. Keep rollback commands handy: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeds --to-revision=1.4.0` and traffic cut script: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/traffic/cut?service=embeds&target=1.4.0`

deploy-bot: Canary started on embed-canary-07. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/1813456789

sre-jai: Canary p95 back to baseline after 4m. No error spike. Proceeding to 20% ramp.

deploy-bot: 20% reached. Monitoring 10m checkpoint.

oncall-maria: 6m into 20%: observed a transient GC pause on canary host at +120ms p95, not reproduced on replicas. Holding ramp until 2m stability.

eng-release: Can we repro locally? I pushed a quick probe to simulate tiny-batch routing. No repro on staging. Might be noisy node. Recommend move canary to embed-canary-09 and continue.

sre-jai: Moving canary host now. New canary: embed-canary-09. Health checks PASS after 3m.

deploy-bot: Resuming ramp -> 60% now.

sre-jai: 10m observation at 60%: metrics stable. No trigger breaches.

deploy-bot: Finalizing rollout -> switching 100% to rwinference/embeds:1.4.1-hotfix. Deployment complete. SHA: fedcba9876.

release-mgr-olivia: Great. Scheduling 1h post-deploy check and 3h postmortem if anything anomalous. Will update release notes and send customer note after 30m. :white_check_mark:

oncall-maria: Pager remains on for 2h. If I post "ROLLBACK INTENT" I will include the metric snapshot and execute rollback commands.

eng-release: Follow-up: add an alert for tiny-batch routing failures and add a unit test for fallback hash. Jira: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENG-9999

release-mgr-olivia: Closing thread—hotfix rolled. Thanks team. :party-parrot:"
